info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Investment Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Investment Management Update API enables businesses to modify specific investment account details based on unique identifiers. This endpoint allows users to apply partial updates to investment accounts, ensuring data accuracy and relevance. Typical consumers include financial institutions and investment firms aiming to enhance their account management processes. With this API, organizations can respond dynamically to client needs and maintain up-to-date investment records.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific investment account identified by its unique account number. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify the account information as required.

requestBody.description: Request body to update the investment account identified by ACC-200045. This body should contain the necessary fields and values to modify the account's attributes accordingly.

200.description: Request processed successfully and the investment account is updated.
